fields.why: This is an awareness-month notice, and every figure is cited from references 1-4. Under v5 a report of cited figures only has outcome_types [].
The article computes nothing of its own; under v5, cited figures only give analytic_depth [], as for none.
The 1988-1998 decline (9.7 to 5.9 per 100,000, a 39% fall) is cited from refs 1 and 2. In a limited report, method fields cover only what the article computes itself.
With no comparison of the article's own, scale is null; the cited percent change is not the report's contrast.
The brief maps announcements and awareness notices to mixed/other. The piece designates a prevention month and issues no guidance or recommendations.
